messages:
sara-docs: FYI I'm holding docs PR #4127 — docs preview failed and there's a runtime question about prefetch defaults in SDK snippet. @mike-runtime @tom-ml can you confirm behavior so we can unblock the merge?

ci-bot: docs-preview CI failed: linkcheck error on /sdk/snippets/prefetch -> 404; also runtime tests show mismatch for default TTL in examples. Logs: ```linkcheck: GET /sdk/snippets/prefetch -> 404
runtime: prefetch.default_ttl expected 60 but test asserts 0```

mike-runtime: I saw the CI. Quick note: runtime currently treats prefetch TTL differently between hosted vs dedicated. Hosted default is 60s, Dedicated inherits cluster-level cache_ttl (usually 300s) unless explicitly set. That nuance isn't in the docs snippet.

laura-eng: do we have a canonical place in the API docs to state "deployment-specific defaults"? The broken link points at the snippet anchor we added. Maybe the anchor changed after the last docsbuild.

tom-ml: For the SDK example, the code currently shows: ```js
const client = new Redwood({prefetch: {enabled: true}})
// expects default TTL 60
```
But that implies a single global default which is misleading. We should either show an explicit TTL or add a note about hosted/dedicated variance.

mike-runtime: Agreed. Two options: 1) change snippet to set TTL explicitly (safe), or 2) add a short sentence: "Defaults depend on deployment; set prefetch.ttl to guarantee behavior." I prefer option 1 for docs PRs that are about examples.

nina-devex: for merge policy: we can merge with label "docs/merge-hold" if runtime files an internal follow-up to update platform-defaults doc. But CI linkcheck must pass. Who will fix the anchor?

laura-eng: I'll open a tiny docs change to fix the anchor path (looks like /sdk/snippets/prefetch -> /sdk/snippets/prefetching). Should be quick. Once linkcheck passes we can re-run preview.

tom-ml: I'll update the SDK snippet in the PR to include an explicit ttl value and a short comment: ```js
const client = new Redwood({prefetch: {enabled: true, ttl: 60 /* hosted default; set explicitly to override */}})
```
That should remove ambiguity and make examples accurate across deployments.

mike-runtime: I'll also create an internal issue to document cluster-level cache_ttl behavior for Dedicated and link it from the API defaults page. I'll add the issue number in a follow-up comment so docs can link it.

sara-docs: Sounds good. Plan: laura will fix the anchor, tom will update snippet to explicit ttl, mike will file the internal issue and post link, then we re-run docs-preview. If linkcheck and preview pass, I'll remove the "hold" label and merge. Leaving the PR blocked until all three are done. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: rerun requested — waiting on new push to PR #4127 to perform fresh preview.
